methodology.missingData: Missing OSM or Mapillary evidence is treated as unknown, not proof that the physical feature is absent.

mrtClusterRecognisability.note: Exploratory leave-one-out nearest-centroid recognisability test based on extracted visual features. This is descriptive evidence and is not a validated predictive classifier.

methodology.visualClustering: K-means clustering of standardised computer-vision feature vectors.
methodology.demographicClustering: Demographic SOM assignment is independent from K-means visual clustering.
methodology.recognisability: Exploratory leave-one-out nearest-centroid recognisability test based on extracted visual features. This is descriptive evidence and is not a validated predictive classifier.
